verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a consumer mobile one-time-passcode generator (HOTP/TOTP) with no developer API or production data environment. A sandbox or test environment for agentic testing is therefore a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability; the 'Use without an account' local mode is an account choice, not a sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
